mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% for two consecutive months triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 and remains above for ≥2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the identified inflation spike, or CPIAUCSL reverts below 3% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PAYEMS labor cost growth of at least 0.5% monthly for three months is associated with higher wage growth expectations, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS average monthly growth ≥ 0.5% over 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative during the labor cost expansion, or wage growth decelerates below 0.3% in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 (goods demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 2% over 5 trading days predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days due to demand softening.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev by ≥2% AND RSAFS < prev by ≥2% in the same window
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite the 5-day demand shock, or both proxies recover within 3 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) index below 100 for two consecutive months signals supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 and remains below for ≥2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the INDPRO contraction, or production recovers within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 4 consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 60 trading days as higher policy rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during the high-rate period, or FEDFUNDS reverts before 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4% for 3 months indicates weaker labor market conditions, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during the low-unemployment period, or UNRATE recovers before 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in HOUST housing starts by at least 10% in a single month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days due to reduced economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prev * 0.9 in a single month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative, or HOUST recovers within 3 days.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and GDPC1 both show a double-dip recession pattern (two consecutive months below trend), the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 20 days due to persistent supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < trend for 2 months AND GDPC1 < trend for 2 months (consecutive)
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the double-dip, or either index recovers within 1 month.
